units.source_scale_reason: One fixed anatomical scale per original source matches the existing approximately 233px reel-top-to-sole body. Pelvis and planted soles provide registration; no per-pose resizing or deformation.

visual_review.notes: All 56 original frames reviewed at Godot 128px reference height. Nine masters preserve the stocky respirator soldier, 233px reel-to-sole source silhouette and correct near rope/far crank hands. Short melee swing and longer overhead ranged cast have distinct windups and recovery; brace/recoil, open far-hand support signal and grounded collapse are readable. Corrected release removes extra hand from first proposal. Foreground passing and background reach originals complete reciprocal gait. No per-pose deformation or resizing; unused/rejected original poses and exact lineage retained.
